ratings.comment: I had him for 2 semesters and I loved the way he taught his students. HE REALLY IS SOOOOO NICE. I f you get the chance to take his course, you are lucky.
A great guy, very lax and understanding

Professor Langer is a really kind guy who obviously knows a lot about his subject matter.  Participate in class because he gets really excited when you do. Overall pretty easy class, and go to his office hours so he knows you care about the class!
Amazing and really nice guy! Learned a lot!
Ullrich Langer is amazing.  If you have the chance to take his class, do it!

I've had Professor Langer for 2 classes, and he has been my favorite French professor at UW-Madison. His exampaper expectations are clear and straightforward. He is soft-spoken; however, he is very clever and has insightful ideas. If you have a chance to take a class with him, I'd recommend it.

Overall Langer is a great professor. He REALLY knows the material and he's very clearly passionate about it. Sometimes his lectures were hard for me to follow because he writes all over the place on the white board, and sometimes jumps around topics. That said, it wasn't difficult to understand overall.

Amazing teacher, really knows his stuff. Grade based on 5 take home essays and small quizzes. As long as you read and attend class, the essays are easy. He is truly interested in your approach to the essay questions. Quiz phrases are given out before hand, and you write a short paragraph about the phrase.

i LOVED this prof. he knows everything and speaks like 5 languages. he is the most adorable man too and is genuinely interested in what he teaches. there is minimal emphasis on book material but be sure to attend class, the exams are 100% based on class notes. the exams are very straightforward and doable, study and you'll be fine.

GREAT PROFESSOR!  I learned so much in this class!  It's entirely lecture based so you NEVER have to worry about participating.  You don't even need to read the book because his lectures are so clear and concise.  Exam questions are given out in advance so it's easy to prepare.  Overall, really smart guy and very interesting class!
